outcome: annual health care resource use (cardiology visits, cardiac testing, medications)
medication use (angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors/angiotensin receptor blockers)
cohort: The study included 1386 male patients aged 1 to 18 years with Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy, identified from the IBM MarketScan Research Database between January 2013 and December 2017.
finding: Children aged 10 to 18 years had higher rates of cardiac resource use compared with those under 10 years, but the overall rates in both age groups did not meet guideline recommendations.
